summary: URL-encoded query strings must decode plus-as-space and percent sequences.

task.title: Decode application/x-www-form-urlencoded pairs
task.description: parse_query(query) receives a query string without a leading '?'. Return a dict of decoded keys and values. '+' is a space. Percent-encoded octets must be decoded. Duplicate keys keep the last value. A key with no '=' has an empty string value.
constraints: Use only the Python standard library.
